chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The 'Asr prayer is at two cubits, so whoever leaves it until it becomes at six feet, then that is the one who is neglectful.

key_terms.اَلْمُضَيِّعُ: the one who is neglectful or wasteful regarding the prayer
key_terms.ذِرَاعَيْنِ: two cubits, indicating a prayer-time measure
key_terms.سِتَّةِ أَقْدَامٍ: six feet, indicating a later time measure

ai.seo_question: When does the time of the 'Asr prayer begin, and when is delaying it considered neglect?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies an early preferred time for the 'Asr prayer and condemns delaying it excessively. It serves as a fiqh indication regarding the timing of salat and the blameworthiness of negligence in performing it on time.
